latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Daily Work Report Generator skill.
- Automatically finds all git repositories with commits for a given date across all branches.
- Collects CodeBuddy Agent session summaries for the target date.
- Generates a structured daily report (in English or Chinese) summarizing commits, code changes, and agent sessions.
- Supports custom date selection using --date, --yesterday, or --days-ago flags.
- No configuration required; advanced settings available via config file.
